about: Vectors for the x402/upto/solana pairing (the x402-upto-solana entry point of @integraledger/lcp). Expected values use x402-exact-solana.json's fixed inputs (receiverAuthorizer from seed 03x32; nonce 7; openSlot 341000000; amount 10000; withdrawDelay 3600), computed with solders 0.26.0, PyNaCl 1.6.2 and @noble/curves 2.4.0. The fixtures (EU5's landed wire, the no-channel transaction, the plants' wires) were built with solders 0.26.0 on Python 3.11; the same script reproduces EU1, EU3 and EU5's txid. The no-channel message's digest, d4e6becc...1c47, is recorded here in full. EU5 is a landed opening and a transaction with no channel instruction, read by recover and bound; transactionV1's statusRows read the stock version-1 opening back, and the read's own cases are in svm-read.json; each reference names the option's payee. transactionV1 is the version-1 transaction (SIMD-0385) the stock @x402/svm 2.31.0 client writes, run offline as its case states; its landed wire adds the fee payer's signature made with @noble/curves 2.4.0.

EU3.case: The opening build(...) writes with the fixed inputs. messageLength, messageSha256 and the wire (wireBase64, wireLength, wireSha256Prefix) are of the message as solders 0.26.0 compiles it, the account keys of each class in byte order; payerSignaturePrefix and payerSignatureSuffix are of the payer's signature over it. build compiles the same instructions with its account keys in @solana/kit's order, the order of the steward SDK, whose upto client opens its channel with buildOpenPaymentChannelTransaction, which compiles with @solana/kit (x402-foundation/x402 751590a2, typescript/packages/mechanisms/svm/src/upto/client/scheme.ts L74 and typescript/packages/mechanisms/svm/src/payment-channels/open.ts L501-516); buildMessageSha256 is the SHA-256 of that message, computed with @solana/kit 8.4.0 as getCompiledTransactionMessageEncoder of compileTransactionMessage of EU3's wire message decompiled, and node:crypto's SHA-256. instructions are the message decompiled. lcp compiles with the same @solana/kit, so the value is independent of lcp in its input, solders' message, and not in its compiler. buildWireSha256 is the SHA-256 of the wire complete writes for the payer's signature over that message, written by hand from the Solana transaction format: the compact-u16 count of required signatures, one 64-byte slot per required signer, zero but for the payer's, which holds the payer's Ed25519 signature (RFC 8032) of the message with fixed.payerSeed, then the message. It is computed in Python 3.12.3 without @solana/kit: the message compiled by hand in @solana/kit's account order (the fee payer; then signers before non-signers and writable before read-only; then the base58 text as Intl.Collator("en", {caseFirst: "lower"}) orders it) from the solders wire, giving buildMessageSha256; the signature with cryptography 50.0.1's Ed25519, and the hash with hashlib.
EU3.accountsAbout: each account is [address, signer, writable] as the compiled message gives them: the fee payer's three uses merge into one writable signer key

plant.case: EU3's instructions with x402's random-nonce memo
EU3's opening with its memo's hex in upper case, echoed as accepted.extra.memo: the carrier is L exactly. The wire is EU3's with those 64 bytes substituted; bound verifies no signature

transactionV1.case: A version-1 transaction as the stock client writes it: @x402/svm 2.31.0 (npm, the devDependency this package pins), run offline: the payer's key from Ed25519 seed 01x32 (@solana/kit 8.4.0 createKeyPairSignerFromPrivateKeyBytes), the clock at now, the option's extra.recentBlockhash as the lifetime and transactionVersions [0, 1] as a stock facilitator advertises them (scheme_exact_svm.md §1.5 at x402-foundation/x402 88b66dd4), so the client builds version 1, the highest version both sides admit; the client makes no RPC read, the option naming its token program and its recentSlot, the salt's 8 random bytes 07 and seven zeros, so the payload's nonce is 7 and its channelId EU1's channel. bound gives H from the one memo, extra.memo; reference gives the message's digest, the fee payer and the blockhash. landedWireBase64 is the stock wire with the fee payer's Ed25519 signature (seed 02x32, @noble/curves 2.4.0) of the message in signature slot 0; txid is that signature in base58. The message is every byte before the signatures (SIMD-0385, Transaction V1 Specification, at solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents ae7b00f3), and messageSha256 is SHA-256 over it (node:crypto). status of the landed wire's reference, its transaction the txid, read back through a constructed reader (the buyer's account listing the txid with its memo as getSignaturesForAddress renders it; getTransaction holding it at finalized, or at confirmed alone, with the token balances getTransaction gives for each token account its TransferChecked names, the source the payer's and the destination the payee's; the finalized slot 1,100, the confirmed one 1,120; the blockhash valid at slot 1,000), answers each row's expect at the one mark, finalized (read-status rules 13, 17, 23 to 25): settled, with what moved and presented yes; pending, below-mark, naming it with no finality, where only confirmed holds it; and, with an error, pending, search-incomplete, since the search's gate holds the payer's own failed transaction while the search proves no absence. recover gives H. changed holds the stock wire with one member changed, each refused by bound with its code; landedChanged is the landed wire with the memo changed as changed's first row, read under the same txid, which status answers pending, instrument-live, since its message digest is not the reference's, so it consumed nothing and is no act carrying H, and the blockhash's validity has not passed

statusRows.case: the landed wire at finalized: settled, what moved named by its transaction and place, presented yes
the landed wire at confirmed alone, the latest head and no mark: pending, below-mark, naming it with no finality
the landed wire at finalized with an error, the payer's own failed transaction: the search's gate holds it, pending, search-incomplete

changed.case: the memo's last character, d, changed to e inside the signed message: the memo carries another hash than extra.memo's
the version byte 129 changed to 130, a message version SIMD-0385 does not define
one byte appended after the signatures, where SIMD-0385 admits none

landedChanged.case: the landed wire with its memo changed, under the same txid: no act carrying H and not the message presented, so the value reads unconsumed: pending, instrument-live

build.case: lcp's build of the same inputs the stock client was given, under presented.accepted offered alone in a document: its extra.transactionVersions holds 1, so it builds version 1, and the message it asks the payer to sign is the stock client's message byte for byte, every byte of presented's wire before the signatures as @solana/kit 8.4.0's getTransactionDecoder reads messageBytes. input is the choice beside the document and option; a bigint member is written in decimal. The nonce is the salt the stock client drew from its random bytes (7), the open slot extra.recentSlot, and the compute budget build's default, 200000 units at 1 micro-lamport, the stock open's OPEN_DEFAULT_COMPUTE_UNIT_LIMIT and DEFAULT_COMPUTE_UNIT_PRICE_MICROLAMPORTS (dist/esm/chunk-DP3B4MQJ.mjs:931; chunk-DAIKIZVB.mjs:13).

transactionVersions.case: build of EU3's input, the advertised option with extra.transactionVersions set to each row's value, or without it for the row that has none, both in the document and as the chosen option. scheme_exact_svm.md §1.5 at x402-foundation/x402 88b66dd4: extra.transactionVersions holds the transaction message versions the sponsor accepts, the JSON integers 0 and 1; when it is absent the accepted set is [0]; a field holding any other entry is invalid; @x402/svm 2.31.0's resolveTransactionVersion (dist/esm/chunk-DAIKIZVB.mjs:289-309) builds the highest version both admit and refuses a value that is not an array, an entry other than 0 and 1, and an empty list. The rule: the client builds as the stock clients do, the highest version both the offer's list and this package admit, version 1 where the list holds 1, version 0 where it holds 0 alone or is absent; an offer whose list admits neither, a field that is present and is not a non-empty array of the integers 0 and 1, is refused at the option filter, before the buyer signs. A row whose field holds 1 is built as version 1, its first byte 129 and its SHA-256 transactionV1.messageSha256, the open @x402/svm 2.31.0's upto client writes for the same inputs (transactionV1); a row whose field holds 0 alone, or that has none, is built as the file's version-0 message, its first byte 128 and its SHA-256 EU3.buildMessageSha256; any other row is refused x402/option-malformed by the option filter, with no request to sign.

agreedRefusals.about: Refusal codes the specification leaves to the implementation. A row with choice is build(choice, H). A row with h is build of EU3's choice, the advertised option with fixed's payer, nonce, openSlot, now, tokenProgram and blockhash as recentBlockhash, with that h.

buyer.about: The buyer gate's rows for this file's pairings, in the form of buyer.json's rows. B2 is the plant: the document advertises H, the hash of the ATR in B6's first check, and the link serves the planted ATR, that ATR with one byte changed; the gate declines hash-mismatch and never calls the signer. B6 is the pairing's bound check over the payment this file already holds: check(ATR, presented) gives H, and check(planted ATR, presented) declines signed-not-bound. Where the ATR is abc, H is its SHA-256 (FIPS 180-2 B.1) and the planted ATR is abd. SHA-256 values are GNU coreutils sha256sum, which openssl dgst -sha256 matches. Bytes are hex. A B2 input names the account, the buyer's inputs and the time (now, in seconds) its build needs. noSignedPayment names each pairing of the file that has no B6 row, and why.
